Look at the pillar in the middle of the room. The first word indicates where to tell Itzla to stand, and the second word where you craft the essence.1 is the north-east altar, and incrementing numbers rotate clockwise. The words mean the following numbers: 
    Oma = 2
    Naui = 4
    Kuli = 5
    Chaki = 6
    Koma = 7
    Ueai = 8
    Makti = 10

Start with Protect from Missiles.

Use the gaps in the wave attacks to dodge the walls as they approach. 

If circles appear, stand where they appeared.

Every time a teleporter appears to jump over a wave, the boss will switch attack styles alternating between mage and ranged. 

The boss will enter an enrage phase, it is much easier to range but melee is still possible. 

Attack the boss and then immediately click on the next teleporter to avoid taking damage.
